items.title: Monero Sinks Below $400 as Privacy Rival Zcash Rallies
items.summary: Monero fell more than 10% in 24 hours on Kraken, while bitcoin and ether barely moved.

items.title: Bitcoin price drops below $59K as Anthropic joins tech stock rebound
items.summary: Bitcoin price volatility returned at the Wall Street open as BTC/USD dropped to local lows of $58,700 while stocks and gold headed higher.

items.title: AI-Powered GTA 6 PC Ports Now Have Multiplayer as Modders Unlock 30 and 60 FPS
items.summary: Modders have added multiplayer to an unofficial PC port and unlocked higher frame rates on jailbroken consoles.

items.title: Tether buys $10 million of Bitdeer shares as stock hovers near all-time low
items.summary: USDT issuer Tether spent about $10 million earlier this week to acquire 3.72 million Bitdeer Class A ordinary shares.
